_comment: Config for scripts/srt-registry-inputs/aggregate_to_cln.py. Like the issuer-mapping, this is the ONLY thing that changes per client/registry layout -- the bucket logic and the CLN formulas do not. Points the aggregator at whichever columns this registry happens to use; the script maps them to the fixed CLN buckets.
_external_rating_cols_note: List every agency-rating column present. The script picks, per obligor, the rating from the most-populated column and falls back across the rest to maximise coverage.

internal_to_external_map._comment: REQUIRED whenever internal grades are the only ratings. A generic internal scale with NO mapping to external/PD risk is a STOP -- the aggregator flags it for human investigation rather than guessing a bucket.

_include_na: Yes (protocol): NA is kept as its own rating bucket.
_write: Inputs only into cln.xlsx Performance Curves (C, D:H, I, O:U, V:Z). Never write J:N, AB (CDR) or AC (Severity) -- those are formulas. Append a new row for a deal/period not yet present.
